Maya: onboarding Spectra14B-lite -> hit a weird repro on int4 quant + proj-order change. generation quality drops and repeats after ~120 tokens.
Liam: details? scripts/config?
Maya: minimal: convert + int4 calibrate + run llm-sanity with our promptset. config: --quant=int4 --proj-order=kv-to-qk (we tried both orders).
Cheng: can you paste the exact eval snippet?
Maya: here: ```bash
python -m redwood.eval.run 
  --model ./spectra14b/converted/quant-int4/ 
  --prompts tests/longform/critique_prompts.jsonl 
  --batch 8 
  --max-tokens 512
  --proj-order kv_to_qk
```
Maya: triage-bot posted the run: 
triage-bot: [8812345710] smoke: 50 prompts, avg PPL delta +0.7 vs fp16, repeat rate 12% (baseline 1.3%).
Liam: those repeats point to rotary or kv cache misalign. Did token IDs shift?
Maya: tokens look okay on short prompts, long context only. embedding checksum matched pre/post conversion.
Andrea: do attention head dims match expected ordering? On Spectra we have headconcat=true weirdness in checkpoint.
Cheng: I dumped first 6 KV keys for step 0 and step 64, looks like head-permute compared to fp16: ```json
{"k_step0": "...base64...", "k_step64": "...shifted..."}
```
Andrea: hmm that suggests proj-order remap at conversion time. Could be our quant exporter folding proj axes before transpose.
Liam: try re-running conversion with `--preserve-proj-order` flag and regenerate int4 scales. small PR: https://git.local/r/redwood/convert/patch123
Maya: quick try: re-converted with preserve flag, triage-bot new run: [8812345725] smoke: avg PPL delta +0.12, repeat rate 1.5%.
Maya: looks much better.
Andrea: hypothesis: exporter was doing an eager reshape -> quant pack -> transpose; int4 packing made the transpose non-commutative with head concat.
Cheng: filing run notes + dump artifacts to /mnt/onboard/spectra14b/artifacts/8812345670/ (kv_dumps, token_checksums, converter_logs).
Maya: next: run full eval + longform hallucination suite; also check rotary frequency scaling vs baseline (we saw tiny bias).
Liam: I'll add a small unit in converter that asserts pre/post attention weight reorder equivalence for a random seed.
Andrea: nice. tagging @ops for CI GPU time if needed. :eyes:
Maya: thanks all, will update once full eval finishes.
